note: Third-party content, fetched by .github/workflows/render-watch.yml and stored for citation only. fetchedAt is when this stored content was captured, i.e. the last time the page changed - not the last time it was checked; an unchanged page rewrites nothing. Storing bytes is not reading them: a claim becomes [RENDERED] only when a session reads the text and writes the finding into the research file.

frozen.why: A dated copy of the render-watch capture of sweep2-github-marketplace as commit f9a41c6 stored it (fetchedAt above), byte for byte, made by scripts/freeze-capture.mjs so that research/channel-loop/TERMS-AUDIT-2026-09-29.md keeps pointing at the lines that were read. The slug is not in urls.txt, so render-watch never rewrites these files; the live slug sweep2-github-marketplace stays on the weekly watch.
